criteria.no: The statement adds or changes substantive specificity that the quote does not supply.
criteria.unclear: The quote has multiple plausible meanings, so support cannot be settled.
criteria.yes: The statement formalizes a quoted directive without adding substantive specificity; unrelated quoted directives may be separate anchors.

faithful-r3-a-source-coverage.instructions: Does anchor.quote directly support the substantive obligation in anchor.statement? Formal requirement wording and selecting one directive from a multi-directive quote are allowed. Added technical specificity such as an algorithm, strength, mechanism, policy, or outcome absent from the quote is not supported.

criteria.no: At least one required mechanism, strength, policy, condition, or outcome is absent from the quote.
criteria.unclear: Ambiguity in the quote prevents determining support.
criteria.yes: Every required substantive detail is supported or necessarily implied by the quote.

faithful-r3-b-supported-specificity.instructions: Is every substantive detail required by anchor.statement present in or necessarily implied by anchor.quote? Do not require the statement to repeat unrelated directives from the same quote, and treat informal should/need wording as directive provenance.

criteria.no: The action or outcome requires an extra decision not supplied by the quote.
criteria.unclear: The quote is too indeterminate to decide entailment.
criteria.yes: The action and outcome follow from the quote without an extra decision.

faithful-r3-c-atomic-entailment.instructions: For this one atomic statement, does anchor.quote entail its required action and outcome? A longer quote may entail several separate anchors. Formalizing an informal directive is faithful; choosing an unmentioned implementation detail is not.

anchor.quote: CLI output must always be JSON
anchor.statement: Every CLI command must emit JSON to stdout.
